name: Vodafone Group Plc
reason: Mature pan-European telco with revenue down 3.2%/yr over 10y, adjusted EPS only EUR 0.07 (2015) to 0.11 (2025, 4.6% CAGR) and 10y avg ROIC 0.6%; no moat-driven growth route, cheap-but-ordinary.

name: Royal KPN NV
reason: Dutch incumbent telco with revenue -1.9%/yr over 10y, EPS growth from cost cuts and deleveraging (EBIT margin 24.1% vs 19.4% avg, 82nd pctile) and net debt/EBITDA 2.75x; regulated-style mature utility with no durable 7% per-share route.

name: Arcadis NV
reason: Engineering consultancy whose adjusted EPS rose EUR 1.01 (2018) to 3.01 (2024) but fell to 2.67 in 2025, with thin 6.8% EBIT margin, 10y avg ROIC 5.7%, acquisitions 0.4x FCF and the same AI threat to labour-based billing as v1 consultancies.

name: Fielmann Group AG
reason: Dominant German optician with a clear value proposition and 15.7% avg ROIC, but adjusted EPS only EUR 1.98 (2015) to 2.44 (2025, ~2%/yr) and the 12-13% consensus FY2-FY3 rebound rests on an unproven US/Spain expansion partly bought (acq/FCF 0.32).

name: Millicom International Cellular SA
reason: Levered LatAm cable/mobile operator (net debt/EBITDA 2.86x) with erratic EPS (USD -2.62 in 2020, 7.83 in 2025 at a 100th-pctile margin), acquisitions 1.58x FCF and EM currency and political exposure; fails forecastability.

name: Randstad NV
reason: Staffing cyclical whose adjusted EPS fell from EUR 5.67 (2022) to 2.52 (2025, 0.44x its 10y max) on a 2.7% EBIT margin; earnings set by the labour-market cycle with no moat.

name: DCC Energy Plc
reason: Acquisition-led distribution roll-up (acquisitions 0.79x FCF) now refocusing on fuel/LPG distribution, with adjusted EPS GBP 4.56 (2022) to 4.37 (2025), 3.4% EBIT margin and an energy-transition threat to its core volumes.

name: OVS SpA
reason: Italian value apparel retailer with adjusted EPS EUR 0.34 (2015) vs 0.35 (2025), 10y avg ROIC 1.4%, margin at its 10y high (5.8%) and net debt/EBITDA 3.84x; ordinary, lease-heavy, cyclical.

name: Securitas AB
reason: Low-moat guarding business whose EPS jump (SEK 7.65 in 2019 to 11.55 in 2025) came with the Stanley Security deal (acquisitions 1.02x 10y FCF, shares +2.7%/yr) and a 100th-pctile 6.9% EBIT margin; cheap but ordinary.

name: Elis SA
reason: Route-dense textile/hygiene rental with good recurring revenue, but EPS growth (EUR 0.49 to 1.85 over 10y) came largely from acquisitions (0.93x FCF, Berendsen) with shares +8.7%/yr, 10y avg ROIC only 2.9% and a 61% adjusted-vs-GAAP gap.

name: CTS Eventim AG & Co. KGaA
reason: Dominant European ticketing platform with net cash (-2.3x EBITDA), 19.8% avg ROIC and adjusted EPS EUR 0.98 (2015) to 2.89 (2025, 11.4% CAGR) despite COVID; secular live-events growth gives a plausible 9-10% route (consensus FY2-FY3), though LTM FCF swings with ticket float.

name: Tecnicas Reunidas SA
reason: Oil-and-gas EPC contractor with lumpy project earnings (EPS EUR -0.15 in 2019, 1.96 in 2025), 10y FCF conversion -0.01 and avg ROE -1.0%; earnings set by hydrocarbon capex cycles and fixed-price project risk.

name: Bridgepoint Group Plc
reason: PE/credit fund manager whose earnings depend on fundraising and carry realisations (GAAP EPS GBP 0.15 in 2022 to 0.05 in 2025, adjusted gap 137%) with ECP acquisition spend 1.2x FCF; capital-markets earner like HLNE/BX in v1.

name: Societe BIC SA
reason: Mature lighters/pens/shavers maker with adjusted EPS falling from EUR 6.75 (2015) to 4.60 (2025, -3.8%/yr), EBIT margin down from 19-20% to 12.8% and consensus growth ~6%; declining categories, no growth route.

name: Fluidra SA
reason: Pool-equipment duopolist with a good aftermarket base, but adjusted EPS EUR 1.72 (2021 peak) to 1.18 (2025) shows discretionary/housing cyclicality, history shaped by the Zodiac merger (shares +5.4%/yr) and net debt/EBITDA 2.34x.

name: Newag SA
reason: Polish rolling-stock maker dependent on lumpy state rail tenders, with GAAP EPS at a 10y high (PLN 7.91, margin 91st pctile), consensus FY3 -22% and the 2023 train software-lock controversy; cyclical peak plus governance risk.

name: Aperam SA
reason: Stainless steel producer whose earnings follow nickel/steel prices (adjusted EPS EUR 12.16 in 2021 vs 0.92 in 2025, EBIT margin -0.1%) with net debt/EBITDA 3.91x; commodity earner.

name: Stroeer SE & Co. KGaA
reason: Ad-cyclical out-of-home/digital media group with adjusted EPS EUR 3.72 (2019) to 2.78 (2024, 5y CAGR -5.7%), net debt/EBITDA 2.8x and an 85% adjusted-vs-GAAP gap; no demonstrated growth route.

name: Glencore plc
reason: Commodity producer/trader whose adjusted EPS swings with coal and metal prices (USD 1.26 in 2022 to 0.20 in 2025, 0.16x its 10y max) and net debt/EBITDA 3.87x; commodity earner.

name: Vivendi SE
reason: Post-2024-split holding company (Gameloft plus UMG/Telecom Italia stakes) under Bollore control with EBIT margin -34.2% and adjusted EPS EUR 0.02 in 2025; a holding-company discount play, not a forecastable operating business.
